facebook.content_angle: Why the first two weeks after listing your East Auckland home are the most critical — and how to make them count
facebook.post_text:
The first two weeks on the market can make or break your sale. 🏡

Most homeowners don't realise it, but the moment your home goes live, the clock starts ticking. Buyers notice how long a property has been sitting — and a slow start sends the wrong signal.

Here's what happens when you get those first two weeks right:
👉 Serious buyers act fast when they see a well-prepared, well-priced home
👉 Early momentum creates competition — and competition drives price
👉 A strong launch builds perceived value that's hard to recover if you miss it

That initial window is your single biggest opportunity to achieve a premium result. ✨

✔️ Presentation, pricing strategy, and marketing all need to be dialled in before day one
✔️ Professional photography and targeted digital reach matter more than ever in East Auckland's active autumn market
✔️ Working with an agent who plans your launch — not just lists your home — is the difference

Are you thinking about selling this autumn and want to know how to plan your launch the right way?
